name: bulkhead
description: Guard for dangerous shell commands: blocks the catastrophic and stops the risky for a person to run or confirm.

confirmStyle.title: Risky commands
confirmStyle.description: block refuses them and asks the user to run them; ask opens the permission dialog, which auto mode leaves to its classifier.

extraBlock.title: Extra block rules
extraBlock.description: Regular expressions, one per line, matched against each part of a command. A match is always refused.

extraConfirm.title: Extra confirm rules
extraConfirm.description: Regular expressions, one per line. A match asks for permission, or is refused in modes that ask nobody.

disabledRules.title: Disabled rules
disabledRules.description: Built-in rule ids to turn off, separated by spaces or commas (for example git-discard).
